title: Connect both smoke representations to production fixed ticks
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Bind F8-10/F8-16 particle-smoke and grid-smoke operators to the native fixed-tick schedule, retaining grid stencil operations and common collision/obstacle indexing. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Installed public clients exercise both supported smoke representations: six particle-pressure iterations or twelve grid-projection iterations, one time advance and one spatial publication.
Independent divergence, tracer mass, centroid transport, density and speed-overshoot limits pass on applicable physical GPU execution.
Boundary conditions, sparse fields, topology/resource replacement, cold starts, overflow and rollback use real production state and bounded work.
No separate smoke timestep, CPU physics fallback for GPU execution, repeated collision index build or weakening of quality tolerances.

history.reason: Connected particle and grid smoke to production fixed ticks with protected F8-16 operators, atomic publication, bounded rollback, and CUDA/Vulkan/Android/Metal adapter qualification.
